newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has said her government is taking initiatives to link Bangladesh with the rest of the world through the Asian Highway and Asian Railway. "We can't afford to remain disconnected with other countries in this modern world," she said.
Bangladesh's new president Shahabuddin Ahmed called upon all political parties to shun acrimony and forge unity on the pressing national issues for the good of the people and the country.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia has warned the economy is showing signs of stagnancy and heading towards a famine like situation.
Penal rent effective on containers since May 1995 in the Chittagong Port was pushing up the cost of imports, sources in the shipping circle said.
